# Let's Study MS — School of Mathematics
> One of West Bengal's top mathematical institutes for higher education. Expert preparation for BSc Honours, MSc Entrances, IIT JAM, TIFR, NBHM, ISI and PhD entrances.

## About
- [Home](https://letsstudyms.com/): Overview of the institute, courses, mentors, and success stories
- [Contact](https://letsstudyms.com/contact): Enquiry form, phone numbers, email, and physical address

## Courses
- [Foundation Batch](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/foundation-batch): Build strong mathematical fundamentals for undergraduate students
- [Semester Batch](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/semester-batch): Targeted preparation for semester exams
- [MSc Mathematics Entrances](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/msc-mathematics): IIT JAM, TIFR, ISI, NBHM, CMI entrance coaching
- [MTech / Data Science / MSc Economics](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/mtech-datascience): Specialized preparation for interdisciplinary programs
- [Engineering Mathematics](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/engineering-mathematics): Comprehensive engineering mathematics for all branches
- [PhD Entrances](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/phd-entrances): Advanced preparation for doctoral program admissions
- [Advanced Courses](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/advanced-courses): Specialized topics for research and competitive excellence

## Success Stories
- [Hall of Fame](https://letsstudyms.com/testimonials): Alumni success stories — IIT JAM AIR 37, CSIR NET AIR 6, GATE AIR 25, placements at ISI Kolkata, IISc Bangalore, TIFR, HRI, IIT Bombay, University of Connecticut (PhD)

## Key Facts
- Located in Khardaha, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- Faculty from IIT Kanpur, ISI Kolkata, IISc Bangalore
- Students placed at IITs, ISI, IISc, TIFR, HRI, IISER, and international universities
